name: enrichment_detection
description: TU-level detection enrichment (over- and under-detection) per term under the conditional Poisson-binomial null, with GO elim (GIAP_SPEC.md §7.7.3, §9.3; ADR-0029, ADR-0035; M8-04, M8-06). The table has no coordinate fields.

fields.name: collection
fields.description: Collection of the term

fields.name: term
fields.description: Term ID

fields.name: name
fields.description: Human-readable term name; NA when the resource has none

fields.name: direction
fields.description: Tested direction

fields.name: n_universe
fields.description: Universe size, in TUs (TUs with an eligible gene)

fields.name: n_in_set
fields.description: Term size, in TUs (universe TUs with a member gene; before elim)

fields.name: n_detected
fields.description: Detected universe members, in TUs

fields.name: k_detected_in_set
fields.description: Detected members of the term, in TUs (before elim)

fields.name: n_in_set_genes
fields.description: Eligible genes in the term (M8-04 decision 3)

fields.name: k_detected_in_set_genes
fields.description: Detected eligible genes in the term (M8-04 decision 3)

fields.name: odds_weight
fields.description: Gene-level odds weight of the classic comparison test; NA when unestimated

fields.name: p_classic
fields.description: Gene-level classic p-value (comparison only)

fields.name: p_noelim
fields.description: TU-level p-value on the full term, before elim (M8-04 decision 3)

fields.name: parent_group
fields.description: Most general significant ancestor (by depth, then ID) of a significant GO term, or the term itself; NA otherwise

fields.name: coverage
fields.description: Share of eligible genes with at least one term of this collection

fields.name: stat
fields.description: Test statistic: k_detected_in_set

fields.name: effect
fields.description: Effect estimate: detected TUs of the tested set minus their expectation under the null

fields.name: ci_low
fields.description: Lower CI bound; NA when not estimated (ci_unestimated)

fields.name: ci_high
fields.description: Upper CI bound; NA when not estimated (ci_unestimated)

fields.name: p_value
fields.description: One-sided TU-level p-value (after elim for GO over-detection rows)

fields.name: q_value
fields.description: BH q-value within the collection and direction

fields.name: method
fields.description: Method

fields.name: null_model
fields.description: Null model

fields.name: n_perm
fields.description: Permutations behind the p-value: 0 (exact null)

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Semicolon-joined row flags; tu_recal_skipped marks every row of a run whose TU recalibration was skipped and ora_uncalibrated every row while ADR-0035's attack arms fail (M8-04 decision 13)
